# WO-215: TESTING.md: worktree, web_dist and strict-mode rules
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Agent: docs
Source: CLAUDE-048 (SEC-124, conftest web_dist marking, today's CI lessons)

## Goal
docs/dev/TESTING.md should tell a contributor exactly how to run tests correctly. Document from the code (tests/conftest.py, .github/workflows/build.yml, pages.yml), citing file:line.

## Acceptance criteria
- Worktree rule: tests refuse to run when freemyid imports from another checkout's src/; use PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src (SEC-124 guard in tests/conftest.py).
- web_dist: which tests get it (test_web_*, vendor suites that read web/dist or reuse a test_web_ helper), that they skip without a build in build.yml and run strictly with FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 in pages.yml; how to build locally.
- Browser tests (Playwright/Chromium probe), OS markers, real-scheduler marker, the full-registry vs sample-registry switch (FREEMYID_TEST_NO_FULL_REGISTRY).
- A short "before you deliver" checklist for vendors matching CLAUDE-043/045 (full tests/test_web*.py + tests/codex after a build).

## Allowed paths
- `docs/dev/TESTING.md`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests -k "doc or testing"`
